player_prompt.intro:
A nyi azɔnwá {player_id} le egbe HighSociety (nu 2 ɖo azɔnwá).
Egbe ɖo:  Kaɖi wema ɖeka ɖeka ɖo azɔn ɖeka ɖeka.
Gbɛzɛn:    Egbe ɖeka ɖeka, ɖo azɔn ɖeka ɖeka ɖo kpayɛn 1-11 ɖo bo.
            • Gbɛzɛn ɖo kpayɛn ɖeka wema ɖeka ɖo.
            • Gbɛzɛn ɖo kpayɛn ɖeka ɖo.
            • Tie -> gbɛzɛn ɖeka ɖeka ɖo ɖo ɖeka ɖeka ɖo.
Wema ɖo:    Egbe ɖeka ɖeka ɖo, ɖo **kpayɛn ɖo + wema ɖeka**.
            *Wema ɖo* ɖeka ɖo (tie ɖeka ɖeka -> ɖo ɖeka).

**Gbɛzɛn ɖo**  →  ɖo azɔn ɖeka ɖeka ɖo '[7]' alo '[11]'.
